arxiv-2111-08143.title: Confinement/Deconfinement in 4D compact QED on the lattice
arxiv-2111-08143.creator: Paulo J. Silva
arxiv-2111-08143.description: Abstract It has long been known that there is a phase transition between confined and unconfined phases of compact pure gauge QED on the lattice. In this work we report three manifestations of this phase change as seen in the Landau gauge photon propagator, the static potential, and distribution of Dirac Strings in the gauge fixed configurations.

arxiv-2205-05755.title: Neutrino mass and kinetic gravity braiding degeneracies
arxiv-2205-05755.creator: Ulises Nucamendi
arxiv-2205-05755.description: Abstract Modified theories of gravity yield an effective dark energy in the background dynamics that achieves an accelerated expansion of the universe. In addition, they present a fifth force that induces gravitational signatures in structure formation, and therefore in the matter power spectrum and related statistics.

arxiv-2206-12994.title: Automatic Generation of Product-Image Sequence in E-commerce DOI: 10.1145/1122445.1122456 CCS: Applied computing Online shopping CCS: Information systems Display advertising Conference: Proceedings of the 28th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 14–18, 2022; Washingt
arxiv-2206-12994.creator: Xiaochuan Fan, Chi Zhang, Yong Yang, Yue Shang, Xueying Zhang, Zhen He, Yun Xiao, Bo Long, Lingfei Wu
arxiv-2206-12994.description: Abstract . Product images are essential for providing desirable user experience in an e-commerce platform. For a platform with billions of products, it is extremely time-costly and labor-expensive to manually pick and organize qualified images. Furthermore, there are the numerous and complicated image rules that a product image needs to comply in order to be generated/selected.

arxiv-2212-06747.title: The V-QCD baryon : numerical solution and baryon spectrum Preprint: APCTP Pre2022 - 027 CCTP-2022-8 ITCP-2022/8
arxiv-2212-06747.creator: M. Järvinen, E. Kiritsis, F. Nitti, E. Préau
arxiv-2212-06747.description: Abstract The single baryon solution of V-QCD is numerically computed. The spectrum of spin and isospin modes is also computed by quantizing the light fluctuations around the baryon. It is shown that there is a partial restoration of chiral symmetry at the baryon center.

arxiv-2311-08097.title: Empowering Multi-step Reasoning across Languages via Tree-of-Thoughts
arxiv-2311-08097.creator: Leonardo Ranaldi, Giulia Pucci, Federico Ranaldi, Elena Sofia Ruzzetti, Fabio Massimo Zanzotto ( ⋄ ) {(\diamond)} Human-Centric ART Group,Dep. of Enterprise Engineering, University of Rome Tor Vergata, Italy ( ⋆ ) {(\star)} Department of Computing Science, University of Aberdeen, UK [first_name].[la

Reasoning methods, best exemplified by the well-known Chain-of-Thought (CoT), empower the reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by eliciting them to solve complex tasks in a step-by-step manner.

arxiv-2311-10580.title: Implicit Maximum a Posteriori Filtering via Adaptive Optimization
arxiv-2311-10580.creator: Gianluca M. Bencomo, Jake C. Snell & Thomas L. Griffiths
arxiv-2311-10580.description: Abstract Bayesian filtering approximates the true underlying behavior of a time-varying system by inverting an explicit generative model to convert noisy measurements into state estimates. This process typically requires either storage, inversion, and multiplication of large matrices or Monte Carlo estimation, neither of which are practical in high-dimensional state spaces such as the weight spaces of artificial neural networks.

arxiv-2405-00938.title: Virtual Psychedelia
arxiv-2405-00938.creator: \authororcid Jacob Yenney0009-0002-7008-0694, \authororcid Weichen Liu0000-0002-8576-6130, \authororcid Ying C. Wu0000-0002-9382-8805
arxiv-2405-00938.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by \authororcid Jacob Yenney0009-0002-7008-0694, \authororcid Weichen Liu0000-0002-8576-6130, \authororcid Ying C. Wu0000-0002-9382-8805. We present an approach to designing 3D Iterated Function Systems (IFS) within the Unity Editor and rendered to VR in real-time. Objects are modeled as a hierarchical tree of primitive shapes and operators, editable using a graphical user interface allowing artists to develop psychedelic scenes with little to no coding knowledge, and is easily extensible for more advanced users to add their own primitive shapes and operators.

arxiv-2408-07772.title: Out-of-Distribution Learning with Human Feedback
arxiv-2408-07772.creator: Haoyue Bai, Xuefeng Du, Katie Rainey, Shibin Parameswaran, Yixuan Li
arxiv-2408-07772.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Haoyue Bai, Xuefeng Du, Katie Rainey, Shibin Parameswaran, Yixuan Li. Out-of-distribution (OOD) learning often relies heavily on statistical approaches or predefined assumptions about OOD data distributions, hindering their efficacy in addressing multifaceted challenges of OOD generalization and OOD detection in real-world deployment environments. This paper presents a novel framework for OOD learning with human feedback, which can provide invaluable insights into the nature of OOD shifts and guide effective model adaptation.

arxiv-2410-02725.title: Adaptive Inference-Time Compute: LLMs Can Predict if They Can Do Better, Even Mid-Generation
arxiv-2410-02725.creator: Rohin Manvi*, Anikait Singh, Stefano Ermon
arxiv-2410-02725.description: Abstract Inference-time computation is a powerful paradigm to enhance the performance of large language models (LLMs), with Best-of-N sampling being a widely used technique. However, this method is computationally expensive, requiring both (1) an external reward model and (2) the generation of multiple samples.

arxiv-2502-03861.title: Analysis of Newly Catalogued Open Star Cluster UPK 220 with Gaia DR3 and TESS: Discovering Member Variable Stars Facilities: Gaia(DPAC), TESS(SPOC)
arxiv-2502-03861.creator: İncİ Akkaya Oralhan, Cenk Kayhan, Özgün Arslan
arxiv-2502-03861.description: Abstract Studies on star clusters with the same age and initial chemical composition have gained momentum in recent years with the use of Gaia . In addition, the discovery of new clusters with Gaia has increased the number of open clusters to be examined.

arxiv-2505-23060.title: Self-Correcting Code Generation Using Small Language Models
arxiv-2505-23060.creator: Jeonghun Cho, Deokhyung Kang, Hyounghun Kim, Gary Geunbae Lee
arxiv-2505-23060.description: Abstract Self-correction has demonstrated potential in code generation by allowing language models to revise and improve their outputs through successive refinement. Recent studies have explored prompting-based strategies that incorporate verification or feedback loops using proprietary models, as well as training-based methods that leverage their strong reasoning capabilities.

arxiv-2508-06688.title: A Multi - Wavelength Survey of Transient Lensing Opportunities for Primordial Black Hole Searches
arxiv-2508-06688.creator: Stefano Profumo
arxiv-2508-06688.description: Abstract Gravitational lensing of short astrophysical transients provides a uniquely direct avenue for searching for primordial black holes (PBHs) across a vast range of masses. While past search efforts have focused on particular source classes—such as fast radio bursts (FRBs) and gamma-ray burst spikes—no systematic, multi-wavelength survey has compared their relative potential for PBH discovery.

arxiv-2509-16129.title: Learning the Influence Graph of a Markov Process that Randomly Resets to Past
arxiv-2509-16129.creator: Sudharsan Senthil, Avhishek Chatterjee
arxiv-2509-16129.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sudharsan Senthil, Avhishek Chatterjee. Learning the influence graph G G of a high-dimensional Markov processes is a challenging problem. Prior work [ 1 ] addresses this task when the process has finite memory. However, the more general regime in which the system probabilistically “jumps back in time”—so that the state at t + 1 t{+}1 depends on a sample from a distant past t − d t{-}d —remains unexplored.

arxiv-2511-04077.title: The truth is no diaper: Human and AI-generated associations to emotional words
arxiv-2511-04077.creator: Špela Vintar & Jan Jona Javoršek
arxiv-2511-04077.description: Abstract Human word associations are a well-known method of gaining insight into the internal mental lexicon, but the responses spontaneously offered by human participants to word cues are not always predictable as they may be influenced by personal experience, emotions or individual cognitive styles.

pmc-10795767.title: Foam roller-based self-induced myofascial therapy in patients with hemophilic knee arthropathy: a multicenter, single-blind, randomized clinical study
pmc-10795767.creator: Elena DONOSO-ÚBEDA, Raúl PÉREZ-LLANES, Javier MEROÑO-GALLUT, Roberto UCERO-LOZANO, Rubén CUESTA-BARRIUSO
pmc-10795767.description: BACKGROUNDHemophilia is a congenital coagulopathy characterized by degenerative joint damage. Self-induced myofascial therapy aims to decrease pain and improve tissue mobility, functionality and proprioception.AIMThe aim of this study was to evaluate the safety and efficacy of self-induced myofascial release in patients with hemophilic knee arthropathy.DESIGNThis is a randomized clinical study.SETTINGThis study was carried out in different patient associations.

pmc-11401128.title: EEF1B2 regulates the proliferation and apoptosis of human spermatogonial stem cell lines through TAF4B
pmc-11401128.creator: Zenghui Huang, Ning Li, Xiren Ji, Dai Zhou, Ruijun Wang, Xingguo Zhao, Shuangyao Wang, Huan Zhang, Chuan Huang, Ge Lin
pmc-11401128.description: BackgroundSpermatogonial stem cells (SSCs) are essential for male fertility, maintaining sperm production throughout life. While mouse SSCs have been studied extensively, the mechanisms regulating human SSCs are less understood.ObjectivesTo investigate the role of EEF1B2 in regulating human SSC proliferation and apoptosis.Material and methodsSingle cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) analysis was utilized to investigate the differentially expressed genes of SSC.

pmc-11473730.title: Association of healthy eating index (HEI), alternative healthy eating index (AHEI) with antioxidant capacity of maternal breast milk and infant’s urine: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11473730.creator: Zahra Asadi, Afsane Bahrami, Asghar Zarban, Amir Hassan Asadian, Gordon A. Ferns, Samira Karbasi
pmc-11473730.description: Maternal dietary quality may alter the nutrient content of breast milk. In this study, we aimed to investigate the relationship between the healthy eating index (HEI) and alternative healthy eating index (AHEI) of a breastfeeding mother’s diet with the antioxidant profile of her breast milk and her infant’s urine. This study included 300 healthy mother-infant pairs.

pmc-11502409.title: Macroscale Gradient Dysfunction in Alzheimer's Disease: Patterns With Cognition Terms and Gene Expression Profiles
pmc-11502409.creator: Dawei Wang, Zhuangzhuang Li, Kun Zhao, Pindong Chen, Fan Yang, Hongxiang Yao, Bo Zhou, Yongbin Wei, Jie Lu, Yuqi Chen, Xi Zhang, Ying Han, Pan Wang, Yong Liu
pmc-11502409.description: Macroscale functional gradient techniques provide a continuous coordinate system that extends from unimodal regions to transmodal higher‐order networks. However, the alterations of these functional gradients in AD and their correlations with cognitive terms and gene expression profiles remain to be established. In the present study, we directly studied the functional gradients with functional MRI data from seven scanners.

pmc-11690124.title: THE ASSOCIATION BETWEEN LONELINESS AND CHILDLESSNESS IN MIDDLE TO LATE LIFE: DOES FRIENDSHIP AND GENDER PLAY A ROLE?
pmc-11690124.creator: Alison Rataj, Andrew Alberth, Yan-Jhu Su, Elisabeth Stam, Jeffrey Stokes
pmc-11690124.description: ObjectiveLoneliness is a risk factor for negative health outcomes; however, little attention has been paid to the role of parental status as a contributor to loneliness in later life. Limited research has explored how this association may vary based on levels of friend support, friend strain, and gender.

pmc-12438413.title: Does Psychological Resilience Affect Sexual Satisfaction in Women with Polycystic Ovary Syndrome? A Cross-Sectional Observational Study
pmc-12438413.creator: A. Bicer, A. C. Kahve, D. G. Mert, B. Elmas, E. Göka
pmc-12438413.description: IntroductionPolycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is a common endocrine disorder in women of reproductive age, characterized by hyperandrogenism, oligomenorrhea/amenorrhea, and polycystic ovary morphology. PCOS can negatively impact sexuality due to physical issues like hyperandrogenism, metabolic syndrome, and infertility, as well as the psychological burden of the disease and associated mental health issues.

pmc-12536175.title: Verification of Preferred Reference Genes for RT-qPCR Analysis of Radiosensitivity Gene in Human Peripheral Blood
pmc-12536175.creator: Mingquan He, Xueqin Yang, Yuting Chen, Chaoxian Gao
pmc-12536175.description: ObjectiveHigh-throughput gene expression analysis represents a promising approach for evaluating irradiation doses in vitro. This study aimed to identify preferred reference genes for normalizing RT-qPCR data in human peripheral blood following X-ray irradiation.MethodsWe assessed the stability of GAPDH, 18S rRNA, UBC, HPRT, DPM1, ITFG1, MRPS5, and ACTB, which are commonly utilized in radiation biodosimetry studies.

pmc-12568965.title: Sexual dysfunction in women who received breast cancer treatment: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12568965.creator: Thais Sousa Rodrigues Guedes, Rafael Limeira Cavalcanti, Rebeca de Castro Santana, Nayara Priscila Dantas de Oliveira, Sanderson José Costa de Assis, Johnnatas Mikael Lopes, Diego Neves Araujo, Javier Jerez-Roig, Marcello Barbosa Otoni Gonçalves Guedes, Dyego Leandro Bezerra de Souza
pmc-12568965.description: Breast cancer has a major impact on global public health. This cross-sectional study aimed to investigate the prevalence and associated factors of sexual dysfunction in women who received breast cancer treatment (BCT). Data were collected from sexually active adult women in Natal, Brazil, who had completed at least one year of BCT.

pmc-12817656.title: Intra-articular antibiotic infusions versus intravenous antibiotic administration for infected knee arthroplasty: a study protocol for a randomized multicenter clinical trial
pmc-12817656.creator: Baochao Ji, Yicheng Li, Xiaoyan Yan, Qi Sun, Guoqiang Zhang, Wei Chai, Peng Xu, Jianbing Ma, Yihe Hu, Jie Xie, Zongke Zhou, Huiwu Li, Ping Keung Chan, Weijun Wang, Xinzhan Mao, Wei Huang, Asihaerjiang Maimaitiyiming, Xiaogang Zhang, Guoqing Li, Boyong Xu, Li Cao
pmc-12817656.description: BackgroundPeriprosthetic joint infection (PJI) poses a formidable challenge following total joint arthroplasty (TJA). Whether using Debridement, Antibiotics, and Implant Retention (DAIR) for acute cases or one/two-stage revision for chronic scenarios, postoperative antibiotics administered intravenously is standard. However, this delivery method inevitably risks hepatic and renal function impairment, lacking a sufficiently minimal biofilm eradication concentration.

pmc-13547831.title: Genomic Insights Into the Multimetal Resilience and Biofilm‐Templated Nanorod Biosynthesis of Stenotrophomonas bentonitica BII‐R7: Bioremediation and Green Nanotechnology Implications
pmc-13547831.creator: Eduardo Perez‐Muelas, Miguel Angel Ruiz‐Fresneda, Guillermo Lazuen‐Lopez, Tatiana Lopez‐Perez, Fouad Eddaoudi‐Lakraichi, Mohammed Bakkali, Mohamed Larbi Merroun
pmc-13547831.description: While microbial metal reduction is widely documented, the genomic determinants that govern the morphological transition from disordered phases to structured nanocrystals remain elusive. Here, we present an integrative study of Stenotrophomonas bentonitica BII‐R7, a strain exhibiting exceptional metal resistance and the unique capacity to synthesize crystalline trigonal selenium (t‐Se) nanorods.

pmc-13605887.title: Subjective Xerostomia and Chairside Salivary Dysfunction in Institutionalized Older Adults: Concordance and Exploratory Derivation of a Five-Item Short Form
pmc-13605887.creator: Mădălina Monica Bicheru, Andreea Zamfirescu, Elena Preoteasa, Adrian Iustin Georgevici, Nicolae Vladimir Bicheru, Cristina Teodora Preoteasa
pmc-13605887.description: Background/Objectives: In institutionalized older adults, we examined the concordance between self-reported xerostomia and chairside salivary dysfunction and explored whether a smaller subset of Xerostomia Inventory items could retain comparable screening performance. Methods: This cross-sectional study included institutionalized older adults. The 11-item Xerostomia Inventory was compared with a six-marker chairside whole-saliva panel, with all variables scaled 0 (normal) to 1 (pathological).

pmc-13674829.title: Rare vasculitis types and obstetric and neonatal outcomes – A population‐based study
pmc-13674829.creator: Uri Amikam, Ahmad Badeghiesh, Haitham Baghlaf, Richard Brown, Michael H. Dahan
pmc-13674829.description: ObjectiveVasculitis is an infrequent pathology among reproductive‐aged women. While data exists regarding pregnancy outcomes in the more common vasculitis subtypes, data is limited regarding these outcomes in rare vasculitis subtypes. We aimed to compare pregnancy and perinatal outcomes between women who suffered from rare types of vasculitis and those who did not.
